data.narrative:
Lila Sciences is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn and Molly Gibson, having raised $200M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a broader Biotech & Health sector universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods evaluated, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. This method uses the company's $200M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression to the next funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $400M. Peer-median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient narrowly-comparable datapoints within the Series A / similar-tier subset—only 0 same-stage peers qualified despite 7 total biotech comparables in the database. Public-comp anchoring could not proceed as Lila Sciences does not disclose revenue, a prerequisite for P/S multiples; the sector median P/S of 6.2x across public names remains unusable without target revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. This range reflects uncertainty around stage-progression timing and the lack of direct peer validation. Key unresolved variables include Lila Sciences' revenue run rate (if any), clinical-stage maturity relative to private peers, and whether the $200M raised figure includes off-balance-sheet funding or is on a fully-diluted basis.
